name: bitwarden
title: Bitwarden Vault
description: Search your Bitwarden vault, copy or paste credentials, and generate one-time codes. Requires the Bitwarden CLI (bw) to be installed.
author: black

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Vault
commands.subtitle: Bitwarden
commands.description: Search all items in the authenticated Bitwarden vault.

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.description: The primary action to perform on a vault item.
preferences.title: Primary Item Action

preferences.name: transientCopySearch
preferences.title: Copy Values Temporarily
preferences.description: Whether values should be copied to the clipboard temporarily, and therefore omitted from the clipboard history

commands.name: authenticator
commands.title: Authenticator
commands.subtitle: Bitwarden
commands.description: Search all items with TOTP and generate codes.

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.description: The primary action to perform on an authenticator code.
preferences.title: Primary Code Action

commands.name: generate-password-quick
commands.title: Generate Password (Quick)
commands.subtitle: Bitwarden
commands.description: Generate a password using Bitwarden and copy and/or paste it into the active app right away.

preferences.name: generatePasswordQuickAction
preferences.title: Action to perform after generating
preferences.description: The action performed after generating the password.

data.title: Copy and Paste to Active App

commands.name: logout-vault
commands.title: Logout
commands.subtitle: Bitwarden
commands.description: Logout from your Bitwarden vault account.

commands.name: create-login
commands.title: Create Login
commands.subtitle: Bitwarden
commands.description: Create a new login item in the authenticated Bitwarden vault.

commands.name: create-folder
commands.title: Create Folder
commands.subtitle: Bitwarden
commands.description: Create a folder in the authenticated Bitwarden vault.

preferences.name: clientId
preferences.title: Client ID
preferences.description: The client_id value seen in your Bitwarden account settings.

preferences.name: clientSecret
preferences.title: Client Secret
preferences.description: The client_secret value seen in your Bitwarden account settings.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: Bitwarden CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the Bitwarden CLI. Leave empty to use the first 'bw' found on your PATH. On Arch this is usually /usr/bin/bw.

preferences.name: serverUrl
preferences.title: Bitwarden Server URL
preferences.description: Optional: URL to use for self-hosted servers.

preferences.name: syncOnLaunch
preferences.title: Customization
preferences.label: Sync Vault on Launch
preferences.description: Sync the vault on command launch. If unchecked, the vault will only be synced when the Sync Vault action is used.

preferences.name: fetchFavicons
preferences.label: Fetch Vault Icons
preferences.description: Use the Bitwarden icon server (icons.bitwarden.net) to fetch icons for vault items. If unchecked, built-in icons will be used.
preferences.title: Fetch Vault Icons

preferences.name: repromptIgnoreDuration
preferences.title: Vault Timeout
preferences.description: The amount of time before the password must be re-entered to access the vault again.

preferences.name: windowActionOnCopy
preferences.title: Window Behaviour On Copy
preferences.description: What to do with the window when copying a value to the clipboard.

preferences.name: shouldCacheVaultItems
preferences.title: Performance
preferences.label: Enable Caching
preferences.description: Whether to cache vault items for faster load times. This will NOT cache the actual passwords and other sensitive values, only usernames/emails and other non-sensitive labels.
